import time
import logging
import websocket
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
import requests
import hmac
import hashlib
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, JSON
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, Session
from dataclasses import dataclass
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Cargar variables de entorno desde config/.env en el nuevo path
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'config', '.env'))

@dataclass
class Config:
    api_key: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_KEY", "")
    api_secret: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_SECRET", "")
    use_testnet: bool = os.getenv("USE_TESTNET", "true").lower() == "true"
    symbol: str = os.getenv("SYMBOL", "BTCUSDT")
    timeframe: str = os.getenv("TIMEFRAME", "1").replace("m", "")
    max_iterations: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_ITERATIONS", 1440))
    capital_usdt: float = float(os.getenv("CAPITAL_USDT", 50000.0))
    risk_factor: float = float(os.getenv("RISK_FACTOR", 0.01))
    min_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MIN_TRADE_SIZE", 0.0001))
    max_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MAX_TRADE_SIZE", 0.1))
    fee_rate: float = float(os.getenv("FEE_RATE", 0.002))
    egm_buy_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_BUY_THRESHOLD", 15.0))
    egm_sell_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_SELL_THRESHOLD", -15.0))

# Configuración de logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("BybitTradingEngine")

# URLs para testnet o mainnet
BASE_URL = "https://api-testnet.bybit.com" if Config.use_testnet else "https://api.bybit.com"
WS_URL = "wss://stream-testnet.bybit.com/v5/public/spot" if Config.use_testnet else "wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/spot"

# Base de datos (ajustada al nuevo path en data/)
DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///data/trading.db"
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
Base = declarative_base()
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    action = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entry_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    exit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    quantity = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    profit_loss = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    decision = Column(String, nullable=False)
    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    egm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    rol = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    pio = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ogm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def generate_signature(api_secret: str, params: dict) -> str:
    sorted_params = "&".join([f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(params.items())])
    return hmac.new(api_secret.encode(), sorted_params.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

class BybitTradingEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id()

    def _get_next_trade_id(self) -> int:
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            max_trade_id = db.query(Trade.trade_id).order_by(Trade.trade_id.desc()).first()
            return (max_trade_id[0] if max_trade_id else 0) + 1

    def start(self):
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            WS_URL,
            on_open=self._on_open,
            on_message=self._on_message,
            on_error=self._on_error,
            on_close=self._on_close
        )
        self.ws.run_forever()

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🛑 Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("✅ WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            try:
                data = json.loads(message)
                if "topic" in data:
                    if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                        kline = data["data"][0]
                        candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                        self._store_candle(candle, db)
                    elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                        self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                        self._store_orderbook(db)
                    elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                        ticker = data["data"]
                        self.ticker_data = {
                            "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                            "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                            "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                            "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                        }
                        self._store_ticker(db)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"❌ Error en mensaje: {e}")

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Error en WebSocket: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔌 WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(candle[0]) / 1000, tz=timezone.utc)
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,
                open=float(candle[1]),
                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"✅ Vela guardada: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),
            asks=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["asks"])
        )
        db.add(orderbook)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"✅ Orderbook guardado para {self.symbol}")

    def _store_ticker(self, db: Session):
        ticker = MarketTicker(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            last_price=self.ticker_data["last_price"],
            volume_24h=self.ticker_data["volume_24h"],
            high_24h=self.ticker_data["high_24h"],
            low_24h=self.ticker_data["low_24h"]
        )
        db.add(ticker)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"✅ Ticker guardado: {self.ticker_data['last_price']}")

    def _calculate_ild(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> float:
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return 0.0
        last_price = ticker.last_price
        avg_range = sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
        volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01
        bids = [(float(b[0]), float(b[1])) for b in json.loads(orderbook.bids) if b[0] and b[1]]
        asks = [(float(a[0]), float(a[1])) for a in json.loads(orderbook.asks) if a[0] and a[1]]
        if not bids or not asks:
            bids = [(80500.0, 0.001), (80400.0, 0.002)]
            asks = [(80600.0, 0.001), (80700.0, 0.002)]
        price_shift = max(last_price * Config.price_shift_factor, avg_range * 0.5)
        bids_sum = sum(size for price, size in bids if price >= last_price - price_shift and size > 0)
        asks_sum = sum(size for price, size in asks if price <= last_price + price_shift and size > 0)
        liquidity_pressure = (bids_sum - asks_sum) / (bids_sum + asks_sum + 0.001) if (bids_sum + asks_sum) > 0 else 0
        normalized_ild = 1 / (1 + exp(-liquidity_pressure * 10 * volatility))
        return normalized_ild * (ticker.volume_24h / (last_price * 1000 + 1))

    def _calculate_egm(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> float:
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return 0.0
        last_price = ticker.last_price
        avg_range = sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
        volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01
        price_shift = max(last_price * Config.price_shift_factor, avg_range * 0.5)
        bids = [(float(b[0]), float(b[1])) for b in json.loads(orderbook.bids) if b[0] and b[1]]
        asks = [(float(a[0]), float(a[1])) for a in json.loads(orderbook.asks) if a[0] and a[1]]
        if not bids or not asks:
            bids = [(80500.0, 0.001), (80400.0, 0.002)]
            asks = [(80600.0, 0.001), (80700.0, 0.002)]
        bids_sum = sum(size for price, size in bids if price >= last_price - price_shift and size > 0)
        asks_sum = sum(size for price, size in asks if price <= last_price + price_shift and size > 0)
        pressure_orderbook = (bids_sum - asks_sum) / (bids_sum + asks_sum + 0.001) if (bids_sum + asks_sum) > 0 else 0
        closes = [c.close for c in candles if c.close > 0] or [80500.0] * 5
        momentum = (sum(w * c for w, c in zip([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], closes)) / 15 - closes[0]) / (avg_range or 0.01) / last_price
        return (pressure_orderbook * 0.4 + momentum * 0.6) * 100 * (1 + volatility * 2)

    def _calculate_rol(self, candles: List[MarketData], ticker: MarketTicker) -> float:
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return 0.0
        last_price = ticker.last_price
        avg_range = sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
        volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01
        volume_24h = ticker.volume_24h or 100.0
        liquidity_rate = log(volume_24h * avg_range + 1) / (last_price * len(candles) + 1)
        return liquidity_rate * (1 + volatility)

    def _calculate_pio(self, candles: List[MarketData], ticker: MarketTicker) -> float:
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return 0.0
        last_price = ticker.last_price
        avg_range = sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
        volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01
        profit_potential = (last_price * sum(c.volume for c in candles) * (1 + volatility)) / (avg_range + 1)
        normalized_pio = 1 / (1 + exp(-profit_potential / 1000000))
        return normalized_pio

    def _calculate_combined(self, ild: float, egm: float, rol: float, pio: float) -> float:
        if any(v <= 0 for v in [ild, egm, rol, pio]):
            return 0.0
        volatility = sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in self.candles) / len(self.candles) / self.ticker_data["last_price"] if self.ticker_data["last_price"] > 0 else 0.01
        combined = (ild * 0.25 + egm * 0.4 + rol * 0.3 + pio * 0.05) / (1 + volatility)
        return combined * (1 + volatility * 0.5)

    def _calculate_ogm(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> float:
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return 0.0
        last_price = ticker.last_price
        avg_range = sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
        volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01
        bids = [(float(b[0]), float(b[1])) for b in json.loads(orderbook.bids) if b[0] and b[1]]
        asks = [(float(a[0]), float(a[1])) for a in json.loads(orderbook.asks) if a[0] and a[1]]
        if not bids or not asks:
            bids = [(80500.0, 0.001), (80400.0, 0.002)]
            asks = [(80600.0, 0.001), (80700.0, 0.002)]
        price_shift = max(last_price * Config.price_shift_factor, avg_range * 0.5)
        bids_sum = sum(size for price, size in bids if price >= last_price - price_shift and size > 0)
        asks_sum = sum(size for price, size in asks if price <= last_price + price_shift and size > 0)
        orderbook_pressure = (bids_sum - asks_sum) / (bids_sum + asks_sum + 0.001) if (bids_sum + asks_sum) > 0 else 0
        growth_momentum = exp(orderbook_pressure * 10 * volatility) - 1
        return growth_momentum * (1 + volatility)

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_ticker(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketTicker]:
        return db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketTicker.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        ild = self._calculate_ild(candles, orderbook, ticker)
        egm = self._calculate_egm(candles, orderbook, ticker)
        rol = self._calculate_rol(candles, ticker)
        pio = self._calculate_pio(candles, ticker)
        combined = self._calculate_combined(ild, egm, rol, pio)
        ogm = self._calculate_ogm(candles, orderbook, ticker)

        if egm > Config.egm_buy_threshold and combined > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif egm < Config.egm_sell_threshold and combined < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"✅ Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al colocar orden: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al colocar orden: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=self._calculate_combined(*self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)),
                    ild=self._calculate_ild(candles, orderbook, ticker),
                    egm=self._calculate_egm(candles, orderbook, ticker),
                    rol=self._calculate_rol(candles, ticker),
                    pio=self._calculate_pio(candles, ticker),
                    ogm=self._calculate_ogm(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"✅ Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al cerrar orden: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al cerrar orden: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> tuple:
        ild = self._calculate_ild(candles, orderbook, ticker) if all([candles, orderbook, ticker]) else 0.0
        egm = self._calculate_egm(candles, orderbook, ticker) if all([candles, orderbook, ticker]) else 0.0
        rol = self._calculate_rol(candles, ticker) if all([candles, ticker]) else 0.0
        pio = self._calculate_pio(candles, ticker) if all([candles, ticker]) else 0.0
        return ild, egm, rol, pio

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            logger.warning("⚠️ Datos insuficientes para simular")
            return

        quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
        quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
        order_result = self._place_order(decision, quantity, ticker.last_price, db)
        if order_result["success"]:
            order_id = order_result["order_id"]
            time.sleep(60)  # Espera 1 minuto para cerrar (ajustable)
            latest_ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
            current_price = latest_ticker.last_price if latest_ticker else ticker.last_price
            close_action = "Sell" if decision == "buy" else "Buy"
            close_result = self._close_order(order_id, close_action, quantity, current_price, ticker.last_price, db)
            if not close_result["success"]:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al cerrar: {close_result['error']}")

        self.iterations += 1
        if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
            self.stop()

    def _save_results(self):
        results = {
            "capital_inicial": Config.capital_usdt,
            "capital_final": self.capital,
            "total_pnl": sum(p["profit_loss"] for p in self.positions),
            "trades": self.positions,
            "iterations": self.iterations
        }
        log_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'logs'))
        os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
        json_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "trade_results.json")
        try:
            with open(json_path, "w", encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(results, f, indent=4)
            logger.info(f"📈 Resultados guardados en {json_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al guardar resultados: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bot = BybitTradingEngine()
    bot.start()

import os
import json
import hmac
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, List
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger("BybitTradingEngineUtils")

def generate_signature(api_secret: str, params: dict) -> str:
    """Genera una firma HMAC-SHA256 para las solicitudes a la API de Bybit."""
    sorted_params = "&".join([f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(params.items())])
    return hmac.new(api_secret.encode(), sorted_params.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

def calculate_metrics(candles: List[dict], orderbook: Dict, ticker: Dict) -> dict:
    """Calcula las métricas avanzadas (ILD, EGM, ROL, PIO, COMBINED, OGM) basadas en datos del mercado."""
    if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.get("last_price", 0) <= 0:
        return {
            "ild": 0.0, "egm": 0.0, "rol": 0.0, "pio": 0.0, "combined": 0.0, "ogm": 0.0
        }

    last_price = float(ticker["last_price"])
    avg_range = sum(max(c["high"] - c["low"], 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
    volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01

    # Procesar orderbook
    bids = [(float(b[0]), float(b[1])) for b in orderbook.get("bids", []) if b[0] and b[1]]
    asks = [(float(a[0]), float(a[1])) for a in orderbook.get("asks", []) if a[0] and a[1]]
    if not bids or not asks:
        bids = [(80500.0, 0.001), (80400.0, 0.002)]
        asks = [(80600.0, 0.001), (80700.0, 0.002)]
    price_shift = max(last_price * 0.005, avg_range * 0.5)  # Usamos price_shift_factor default 0.005
    bids_sum = sum(size for price, size in bids if price >= last_price - price_shift and size > 0)
    asks_sum = sum(size for price, size in asks if price <= last_price + price_shift and size > 0)
    orderbook_pressure = (bids_sum - asks_sum) / (bids_sum + asks_sum + 0.001) if (bids_sum + asks_sum) > 0 else 0

    # ILD (Indicator Liquidity Delta)
    liquidity_pressure = orderbook_pressure
    normalized_ild = 1 / (1 + exp(-liquidity_pressure * 10 * volatility))
    ild = normalized_ild * (ticker.get("volume_24h", 100.0) / (last_price * 1000 + 1))

    # EGM (Exponential Growth Momentum)
    closes = [c["close"] for c in candles if c["close"] > 0] or [80500.0] * 5
    momentum = (sum(w * c for w, c in zip([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], closes)) / 15 - closes[0]) / (avg_range or 0.01) / last_price
    egm = (orderbook_pressure * 0.4 + momentum * 0.6) * 100 * (1 + volatility * 2)

    # ROL (Rate of Liquidity)
    volume_24h = ticker.get("volume_24h", 100.0)
    liquidity_rate = log(volume_24h * avg_range + 1) / (last_price * len(candles) + 1)
    rol = liquidity_rate * (1 + volatility)

    # PIO (Profit Index Opportunity)
    profit_potential = (last_price * sum(c["volume"] for c in candles) * (1 + volatility)) / (avg_range + 1)
    normalized_pio = 1 / (1 + exp(-profit_potential / 1000000))
    pio = normalized_pio

    # COMBINED
    combined = (ild * 0.25 + egm * 0.4 + rol * 0.3 + pio * 0.05) / (1 + volatility)
    combined = combined * (1 + volatility * 0.5)

    # OGM (Overall Growth Momentum)
    growth_momentum = exp(orderbook_pressure * 10 * volatility) - 1
    ogm = growth_momentum * (1 + volatility)

    return {"ild": ild, "egm": egm, "rol": rol, "pio": pio, "combined": combined, "ogm": ogm}

def save_results(results: dict, log_dir: str = "logs") -> None:
    """Guarda los resultados en un archivo JSON en el directorio de logs."""
    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    json_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "trade_results.json")
    try:
        with open(json_path, "w", encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=4)
        logger.info(f"📈 Resultados guardados en {json_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"❌ Error al guardar resultados: {e}")

def timestamp_to_datetime(timestamp_ms: int) -> datetime:
    """Convierte un timestamp en milisegundos a datetime con timezone UTC."""
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc)

import os
import time
import logging
import websocket
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, JSON
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, Session
from dataclasses import dataclass
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Importar funciones desde utils
from .utils import generate_signature, calculate_metrics, save_results, timestamp_to_datetime

# Cargar variables de entorno desde config/.env en el nuevo path
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'config', '.env'))

@dataclass
class Config:
    api_key: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_KEY", "")
    api_secret: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_SECRET", "")
    use_testnet: bool = os.getenv("USE_TESTNET", "true").lower() == "true"
    symbol: str = os.getenv("SYMBOL", "BTCUSDT")
    timeframe: str = os.getenv("TIMEFRAME", "1").replace("m", "")
    max_iterations: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_ITERATIONS", 1440))
    capital_usdt: float = float(os.getenv("CAPITAL_USDT", 50000.0))
    risk_factor: float = float(os.getenv("RISK_FACTOR", 0.01))
    min_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MIN_TRADE_SIZE", 0.0001))
    max_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MAX_TRADE_SIZE", 0.1))
    fee_rate: float = float(os.getenv("FEE_RATE", 0.002))
    egm_buy_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_BUY_THRESHOLD", 15.0))
    egm_sell_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_SELL_THRESHOLD", -15.0))

# Configuración de logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("BybitTradingEngine")

# URLs para testnet o mainnet
BASE_URL = "https://api-testnet.bybit.com" if Config.use_testnet else "https://api.bybit.com"
WS_URL = "wss://stream-testnet.bybit.com/v5/public/spot" if Config.use_testnet else "wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/spot"

# Base de datos (ajustada al nuevo path en data/)
DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///data/trading.db"
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
Base = declarative_base()
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    action = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entry_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    exit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    quantity = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    profit_loss = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    decision = Column(String, nullable=False)
    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    egm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    rol = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    pio = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ogm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

class BybitTradingEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id()

    def _get_next_trade_id(self) -> int:
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            max_trade_id = db.query(Trade.trade_id).order_by(Trade.trade_id.desc()).first()
            return (max_trade_id[0] if max_trade_id else 0) + 1

    def start(self):
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            WS_URL,
            on_open=self._on_open,
            on_message=self._on_message,
            on_error=self._on_error,
            on_close=self._on_close
        )
        self.ws.run_forever()

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🛑 Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("✅ WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            try:
                data = json.loads(message)
                if "topic" in data:
                    if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                        kline = data["data"][0]
                        candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                        self._store_candle(candle, db)
                    elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                        self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                        self._store_orderbook(db)
                    elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                        ticker = data["data"]
                        self.ticker_data = {
                            "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                            "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                            "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                            "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                        }
                        self._store_ticker(db)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"❌ Error en mensaje: {e}")

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Error en WebSocket: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔌 WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = timestamp_to_datetime(int(candle[0]))
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,
                open=float(candle[1]),
                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"✅ Vela guardada: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),
            asks=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["asks"])
        )
        db.add(orderbook)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"✅ Orderbook guardado para {self.symbol}")

    def _store_ticker(self, db: Session):
        ticker = MarketTicker(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            last_price=self.ticker_data["last_price"],
            volume_24h=self.ticker_data["volume_24h"],
            high_24h=self.ticker_data["high_24h"],
            low_24h=self.ticker_data["low_24h"]
        )
        db.add(ticker)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"✅ Ticker guardado: {self.ticker_data['last_price']}")

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_ticker(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketTicker]:
        return db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketTicker.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        # Usamos utils para calcular métricas
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        }
        metrics = calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

        if metrics["egm"] > Config.egm_buy_threshold and metrics["combined"] > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif metrics["egm"] < Config.egm_sell_threshold and metrics["combined"] < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"✅ Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al colocar orden: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al colocar orden: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                metrics = self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=metrics["combined"],
                    ild=metrics["ild"],
                    egm=metrics["egm"],
                    rol=metrics["rol"],
                    pio=metrics["pio"],
                    ogm=metrics["ogm"]
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"✅ Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al cerrar orden: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al cerrar orden: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> dict:
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        } if ticker else {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        return calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            logger.warning("⚠️ Datos insuficientes para simular")
            return

        quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
        quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
        order_result = self._place_order(decision, quantity, ticker.last_price, db)
        if order_result["success"]:
            order_id = order_result["order_id"]
            time.sleep(60)  # Espera 1 minuto para cerrar (ajustable)
            latest_ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
            current_price = latest_ticker.last_price if latest_ticker else ticker.last_price
            close_action = "Sell" if decision == "buy" else "Buy"
            close_result = self._close_order(order_id, close_action, quantity, current_price, ticker.last_price, db)
            if not close_result["success"]:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al cerrar: {close_result['error']}")

        self.iterations += 1
        if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
            self.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bot = BybitTradingEngine()
    bot.start()

import os
import time
import logging
import websocket
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, JSON
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, Session
from dataclasses import dataclass
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Importar funciones desde utils
from .utils import generate_signature, calculate_metrics, save_results, timestamp_to_datetime

# Cargar variables de entorno desde config/.env en el nuevo path
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'config', '.env'))

@dataclass
class Config:
    api_key: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_KEY", "")
    api_secret: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_SECRET", "")
    use_testnet: bool = os.getenv("USE_TESTNET", "true").lower() == "true"
    symbol: str = os.getenv("SYMBOL", "BTCUSDT")
    timeframe: str = os.getenv("TIMEFRAME", "1").replace("m", "")
    max_iterations: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_ITERATIONS", 1440))
    capital_usdt: float = float(os.getenv("CAPITAL_USDT", 50000.0))
    risk_factor: float = float(os.getenv("RISK_FACTOR", 0.01))
    min_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MIN_TRADE_SIZE", 0.0001))
    max_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MAX_TRADE_SIZE", 0.1))
    fee_rate: float = float(os.getenv("FEE_RATE", 0.002))
    egm_buy_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_BUY_THRESHOLD", 15.0))
    egm_sell_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_SELL_THRESHOLD", -15.0))

# Configuración de logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("NertzTradingEngine")  # Cambié el nombre del logger para reflejar "Nertz"

# URLs para testnet o mainnet
BASE_URL = "https://api-testnet.bybit.com" if Config.use_testnet else "https://api.bybit.com"
WS_URL = "wss://stream-testnet.bybit.com/v5/public/spot" if Config.use_testnet else "wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/spot"

# Base de datos (ajustada al nuevo path en data/)
DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///data/trading.db"
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
Base = declarative_base()
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    action = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entry_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    exit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    quantity = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    profit_loss = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    decision = Column(String, nullable=False)
    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    egm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    rol = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    pio = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ogm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

class NertzTradingEngine:  # Cambié el nombre de la clase a "NertzTradingEngine"
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id()

    def _get_next_trade_id(self) -> int:
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            max_trade_id = db.query(Trade.trade_id).order_by(Trade.trade_id.desc()).first()
            return (max_trade_id[0] if max_trade_id else 0) + 1

    def start(self):
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            WS_URL,
            on_open=self._on_open,
            on_message=self._on_message,
            on_error=self._on_error,
            on_close=self._on_close
        )
        self.ws.run_forever()

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🛑 Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("✅ WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            try:
                data = json.loads(message)
                if "topic" in data:
                    if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                        kline = data["data"][0]
                        candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                        self._store_candle(candle, db)
                    elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                        self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                        self._store_orderbook(db)
                    elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                        ticker = data["data"]
                        self.ticker_data = {
                            "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                            "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                            "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                            "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                        }
                        self._store_ticker(db)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"❌ Error en mensaje: {e}")

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Error en WebSocket: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔌 WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = timestamp_to_datetime(int(candle[0]))
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,
                open=float(candle[1]),
                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"✅ Vela guardada: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),
            asks=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["asks"])
        )
        db.add(orderbook)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"✅ Orderbook guardado para {self.symbol}")

    def _store_ticker(self, db: Session):
        ticker = MarketTicker(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            last_price=self.ticker_data["last_price"],
            volume_24h=self.ticker_data["volume_24h"],
            high_24h=self.ticker_data["high_24h"],
            low_24h=self.ticker_data["low_24h"]
        )
        db.add(ticker)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"✅ Ticker guardado: {self.ticker_data['last_price']}")

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_ticker(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketTicker]:
        return db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketTicker.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        # Usamos utils para calcular métricas
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        }
        metrics = calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

        if metrics["egm"] > Config.egm_buy_threshold and metrics["combined"] > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif metrics["egm"] < Config.egm_sell_threshold and metrics["combined"] < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"✅ Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al colocar orden: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al colocar orden: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                metrics = self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=metrics["combined"],
                    ild=metrics["ild"],
                    egm=metrics["egm"],
                    rol=metrics["rol"],
                    pio=metrics["pio"],
                    ogm=metrics["ogm"]
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"✅ Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al cerrar orden: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Error al cerrar orden: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> dict:
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        } if ticker else {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        return calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            logger.warning("⚠️ Datos insuficientes para simular")
            return

        quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
        quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
        order_result = self._place_order(decision, quantity, ticker.last_price, db)
        if order_result["success"]:
            order_id = order_result["order_id"]
            time.sleep(60)  # Espera 1 minuto para cerrar (ajustable)
            latest_ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
            current_price = latest_ticker.last_price if latest_ticker else ticker.last_price
            close_action = "Sell" if decision == "buy" else "Buy"
            close_result = self._close_order(order_id, close_action, quantity, current_price, ticker.last_price, db)
            if not close_result["success"]:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo al cerrar: {close_result['error']}")

        self.iterations += 1
        if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
            self.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bot = NertzTradingEngine()  # Usamos NertzTradingEngine en lugar de BybitTradingEngine
    bot.start()

¡Entendido, estimado! El error que estás viendo, sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (sqlite3.OperationalError) unable to open database file, indica que SQLAlchemy no puede abrir o acceder al archivo de la base de datos data/trading.db en la ruta especificada. Esto suele ocurrir por problemas con las rutas, permisos, o porque el archivo no existe o no está en la ubicación correcta. Vamos a diagnosticar y solucionar este problema paso a paso para que tu bot Nertz.py funcione correctamente en PyCharm dentro de NerTzh_.

Análisis del Error
Causa Principal:
El error unable to open database file sugiere que SQLAlchemy no puede encontrar o acceder a data/trading.db en NerTzh_/data/trading.db.
Esto podría deberse a:
El archivo trading.db no existe en NerTzh_/data/.
La ruta relativa sqlite:///data/trading.db no se resuelve correctamente desde src/Nertz.py.
Problemas de permisos en el directorio data/ o el archivo.
El entorno virtual o PyCharm no está configurado correctamente para acceder al directorio.
Advertencia MovedIn20Warning:
Base = declarative_base() genera una advertencia porque SQLAlchemy 2.0 recomienda usar from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base explícitamente. Aunque no es un error crítico, lo corregiré para evitar confusiones futuras.
Solución
Vamos a:

Verificar y corregir la ruta de la base de datos.
Asegurarnos de que trading.db exista o se cree correctamente.
Actualizar el código para usar la nueva sintaxis de SQLAlchemy 2.0.
Probar en PyCharm para confirmar que funciona.

Asegúrate de que NerTzh_/data/trading.db existe. Si no existe, el código intentará crearlo, pero debe tener permisos para hacerlo.

import os
import time
import logging
import websocket
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, JSON
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, Session, declarative_base  # Usamos declarative_base explícitamente
from dataclasses import dataclass
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Importar funciones desde utils
from .utils import generate_signature, calculate_metrics, save_results, timestamp_to_datetime

# Cargar variables de entorno desde config/.env en el nuevo path
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'config', '.env'))

@dataclass
class Config:
    api_key: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_KEY", "")
    api_secret: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_SECRET", "")
    use_testnet: bool = os.getenv("USE_TESTNET", "true").lower() == "true"
    symbol: str = os.getenv("SYMBOL", "BTCUSDT")
    timeframe: str = os.getenv("TIMEFRAME", "1").replace("m", "")
    max_iterations: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_ITERATIONS", 1440))
    capital_usdt: float = float(os.getenv("CAPITAL_USDT", 50000.0))
    risk_factor: float = float(os.getenv("RISK_FACTOR", 0.01))
    min_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MIN_TRADE_SIZE", 0.0001))
    max_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MAX_TRADE_SIZE", 0.1))
    fee_rate: float = float(os.getenv("FEE_RATE", 0.002))
    egm_buy_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_BUY_THRESHOLD", 15.0))
    egm_sell_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_SELL_THRESHOLD", -15.0))

# Configuración de logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("NertzTradingEngine")

# URLs para testnet o mainnet
BASE_URL = "https://api-testnet.bybit.com" if Config.use_testnet else "https://api.bybit.com"
WS_URL = "wss://stream-testnet.bybit.com/v5/public/spot" if Config.use_testnet else "wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/spot"

# Base de datos (ruta absoluta para evitar problemas)
DATABASE_URL = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..', 'data', 'trading.db'))
engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{DATABASE_URL}")
Base = declarative_base()

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    action = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entry_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    exit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    quantity = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    profit_loss = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    decision = Column(String, nullable=False)
    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)

    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    egm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

    ogm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
