engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{DATABASE_URL}")
Base = declarative_base()

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    action = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entry_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    exit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    quantity = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    profit_loss = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    decision = Column(String, nullable=False)
    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    egm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    rol = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    pio = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ogm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

class NertzMetalEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.timeframe = Config.timeframe  # Aseguramos que timeframe esté aquí
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id()

    def _get_next_trade_id(self) -> int:
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            max_trade_id = db.query(Trade.trade_id).order_by(Trade.trade_id.desc()).first()
            return (max_trade_id[0] if max_trade_id else 0) + 1
        finally:
            db.close()

    def start(self):
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            WS_URL,
            on_open=self._on_open,
            on_message=self._on_message,
            on_error=self._on_error,
            on_close=self._on_close
        )
        self.ws.run_forever()

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🦇 Final del riff - Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("⚡ Ritmo metalero iniciado - WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            data = json.loads(message)  # Usamos el json estándar aquí, correcto
            if "topic" in data:
                if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                    kline = data["data"][0]
                    candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                    self._store_candle(candle, db)
                elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                    self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                    self._store_orderbook(db)
                elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                    ticker = data["data"]
                    self.ticker_data = {
                        "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                        "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                        "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                        "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                    }
                    self._store_ticker(db)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Desafío metalero fallido: {e}")
        finally:
            db.close()

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Trueno en el escenario: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔥 Fin del concierto - WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = timestamp_to_datetime(int(candle[0]))
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,
                open=float(candle[1]),
                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"⚡ Nueva nota metalera: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),  # Usamos json.dumps aquí, correcto
            asks=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["asks"])
        )
        db.add(orderbook)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"🤘 Orderbook resonando para {self.symbol}")

    def _store_ticker(self, db: Session):
        ticker = MarketTicker(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            last_price=self.ticker_data["last_price"],
            volume_24h=self.ticker_data["volume_24h"],
            high_24h=self.ticker_data["high_24h"],
            low_24h=self.ticker_data["low_24h"]
        )
        db.add(ticker)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"⚡ Ticker en el escenario: {self.ticker_data['last_price']}")

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_ticker(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketTicker]:
        return db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketTicker.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        # Usamos utils para calcular métricas
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        }
        metrics = calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

        if metrics["egm"] > Config.egm_buy_threshold and metrics["combined"] > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif metrics["egm"] < Config.egm_sell_threshold and metrics["combined"] < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"🤘 Riff de compra/venta - Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el solo: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Caos en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                metrics = self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=metrics["combined"],
                    ild=metrics["ild"],
                    egm=metrics["egm"],
                    rol=metrics["rol"],
                    pio=metrics["pio"],
                    ogm=metrics["ogm"]
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"🔥 Fin del solo - Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el headbang: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Colapso en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> dict:
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        } if ticker else {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        return calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            logger.warning("⚠️ Silencio en el escenario - Datos insuficientes")
            return

        quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
        quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
        order_result = self._place_order(decision, quantity, ticker.last_price, db)
        if order_result["success"]:
            order_id = order_result["order_id"]
            time.sleep(60)  # Headbang de 1 minuto antes de cerrar (ajustable)
            latest_ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
            current_price = latest_ticker.last_price if latest_ticker else ticker.last_price
            close_action = "Sell" if decision == "buy" else "Buy"
            close_result = self._close_order(order_id, close_action, quantity, current_price, ticker.last_price, db)
            if not close_result["success"]:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el mosh pit: {close_result['error']}")

        self.iterations += 1
        if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
            self.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bot = NertzMetalEngine()
    bot.start()

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)

    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)

    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):

class NertzMetalEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.timeframe = Config.timeframe  # Aseguramos que timeframe esté aquí
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id

    @property
    def _get_next_trade_id (self):

     def start (self):
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            WS_URL,
            on_open=self._on_open,
            on_message=self._on_message,
            on_error=self._on_error,
            on_close=self._on_close
        )
        self.ws.run_forever()

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🦇 Final del riff - Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("⚡ Ritmo metalero iniciado - WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        db: SessionLocal     = SessionLocal()
        try:
            data = json.loads(message)  # Usamos el json estándar aquí, correcto
            if "topic" in data:
                if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                    kline = data["data"][0]
                    candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                    self._store_candle(candle, db)
                elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                    self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                    self._store_orderbook(db)
                elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                    ticker = data["data"]
                    self.ticker_data = {
                        "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                        "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                        "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                        "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                    }
                    self._store_ticker(db)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Desafío metalero fallido: {e}")
        finally:
            db.close()

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Trueno en el escenario: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔥 Fin del concierto - WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = timestamp_to_datetime(int(candle[0]))
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,

                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"⚡ Nueva nota metalera: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),  # Usamos json.dumps aquí, correcto

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        # Usamos utils para calcular métricas
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        }
        metrics = calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

        if metrics["egm"] > Config.egm_buy_threshold and metrics["combined"] > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif metrics["egm"] < Config.egm_sell_threshold and metrics["combined"] < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"🤘 Riff de compra/venta - Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el solo: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Caos en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                metrics = self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=metrics["combined"],
                    ild=metrics["ild"],
                    egm=metrics["egm"],
                    rol=metrics["rol"],
                    pio=metrics["pio"],
                    ogm=metrics["ogm"]
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"🔥 Fin del solo - Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el headbang: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Colapso en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> dict:
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        } if ticker else {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        return calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            logger.warning("⚠️ Silencio en el escenario - Datos insuficientes")
            return

        quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
        quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
        order_result = self._place_order(decision, quantity, ticker.last_price, db)
        if order_result["success"]:
            order_id = order_result["order_id"]
            time.sleep(60)  # Headbang de 1 minuto antes de cerrar (ajustable)
            latest_ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
            current_price = latest_ticker.last_price if latest_ticker else ticker.last_price
            close_action = "Sell" if decision == "buy" else "Buy"
            close_result = self._close_order(order_id, close_action, quantity, current_price, ticker.last_price, db)
            if not close_result["success"]:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el mosh pit: {close_result['error']}")

        self.iterations += 1
        if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
            self.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bot = NertzMetalEngine ()
    bot.start ()

Esto está mal porque:
Usaste @property en _get_next_trade_id, pero luego anidaste start dentro de esa definición, lo que hace que start no sea un método de la clase NertzMetalEngine, sino una función local dentro de _get_next_trade_id.
Además, _get_next_trade_id está incompleto y no devuelve nada, lo que causa confusión.
Importación Incorrecta de utils:
Cambiaste from .utils import ... a from src.utils import ..., pero como src/ ya está marcado como "Sources Root" en PyCharm, el import relativo (from .utils import ...) es el correcto. Usar from src.utils import ... puede causar errores si no estás ejecutando desde el directorio raíz adecuado.
Clase SessionLocal Sobrescrita:
Definiste una clase SessionLocal vacía que sobrescribe la SessionLocal generada por sessionmaker de SQLAlchemy. Esto rompe el acceso a la base de datos (data/trading.db), ya que SessionLocal necesita ser creada con sessionmaker(bind=engine).
Otros Detalles:
El diseño general es limpio y minimalista, como te gusta, pero hay pequeños errores de sintaxis (espacios extra, indentación incorrecta) que necesitamos corregir.
El vibe metalero está intacto, y me encanta que quieras mantenerlo así—lo preservaremos al 100%.

Voy a corregir tu código para:

Restaurar el método start como un método de clase válido.
Usar el import relativo correcto (from .utils import ...).
Restaurar SessionLocal con sessionmaker para que funcione con la base de datos.
Mantener el diseño limpio y minimalista, sin sobrecargarlo de validaciones, pero asegurándome de que funcione.

Base = declarative_base()

class MarketData(Base):

    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):

# Restaurar SessionLocal con sessionmaker
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

class NertzMetalEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.timeframe = Config.timeframe  # Aseguramos que timeframe esté aquí
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id()

    def _get_next_trade_id(self) -> int:
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            max_trade_id = db.query(Trade.trade_id).order_by(Trade.trade_id.desc()).first()
            return (max_trade_id[0] if max_trade_id else 0) + 1
        finally:
            db.close()

    def start(self):  # Corregimos para que sea un método de clase válido
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            WS_URL,
            on_open=self._on_open,
            on_message=self._on_message,
            on_error=self._on_error,
            on_close=self._on_close
        )
        self.ws.run_forever()

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🦇 Final del riff - Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("⚡ Ritmo metalero iniciado - WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            data = json.loads(message)  # Usamos el json estándar aquí, correcto
            if "topic" in data:
                if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                    kline = data["data"][0]
                    candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                    self._store_candle(candle, db)
                elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                    self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                    self._store_orderbook(db)
                elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                    ticker = data["data"]
                    self.ticker_data = {
                        "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                        "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                        "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                        "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                    }
                    self._store_ticker(db)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Desafío metalero fallido: {e}")
        finally:
            db.close()

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Trueno en el escenario: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔥 Fin del concierto - WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = timestamp_to_datetime(int(candle[0]))
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,
                open=float(candle[1]),
                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"⚡ Nueva nota metalera: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),  # Usamos json.dumps aquí, correcto
            asks=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["asks"])
        )
        db.add(orderbook)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"🤘 Orderbook resonando para {self.symbol}")

    def _store_ticker(self, db: Session):
        ticker = MarketTicker(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            last_price=self.ticker_data["last_price"],
            volume_24h=self.ticker_data["volume_24h"],
            high_24h=self.ticker_data["high_24h"],
            low_24h=self.ticker_data["low_24h"]
        )
        db.add(ticker)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"⚡ Ticker en el escenario: {self.ticker_data['last_price']}")

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_ticker(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketTicker]:
        return db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketTicker.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        # Usamos utils para calcular métricas
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        }
        metrics = calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

        if metrics["egm"] > Config.egm_buy_threshold and metrics["combined"] > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif metrics["egm"] < Config.egm_sell_threshold and metrics["combined"] < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"🤘 Riff de compra/venta - Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el solo: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Caos en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                metrics = self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=metrics["combined"],
                    ild=metrics["ild"],
                    egm=metrics["egm"],
                    rol=metrics["rol"],
                    pio=metrics["pio"],
                    ogm=metrics["ogm"]
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"🔥 Fin del solo - Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el headbang: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Colapso en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> dict:
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        } if ticker else {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        return calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
        if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            logger.warning("⚠️ Silencio en el escenario - Datos insuficientes")
            return

        quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
        quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
        order_result = self._place_order(decision, quantity, ticker.last_price, db)
        if order_result["success"]:
            order_id = order_result["order_id"]
            time.sleep(60)  # Headbang de 1 minuto antes de cerrar (ajustable)
            latest_ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
            current_price = latest_ticker.last_price if latest_ticker else ticker.last_price
            close_action = "Sell" if decision == "buy" else "Buy"
            close_result = self._close_order(order_id, close_action, quantity, current_price, ticker.last_price, db)
            if not close_result["success"]:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el mosh pit: {close_result['error']}")

        self.iterations += 1
        if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
            self.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bot = NertzMetalEngine()
    bot.start()

import os
import time
import logging
import websocket
import json  # Módulo estándar de Python
from datetime import timezone, datetime
from typing import List, Dict, Optional

# Librerías externas
import websocket
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, JSON
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, Session, declarative_base
from dataclasses import dataclass
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import requests
import hmac
import hashlib

# Importar funciones de utilidades (relativo, correcto para Sources Root)
from .utils import generate_signature, calculate_metrics, save_results, timestamp_to_datetime

# Cargar variables de entorno desde config/.env
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'config', '.env'))

@dataclass
class Config:
    api_key: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_KEY", "")
    api_secret: str = os.getenv("BYBIT_API_SECRET", "")
    use_testnet: bool = os.getenv("USE_TESTNET", "true").lower() == "true"
    symbol: str = os.getenv("SYMBOL", "BTCUSDT")
    timeframe: str = os.getenv("TIMEFRAME", "1").replace("m", "")
    max_iterations: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_ITERATIONS", 1440))
    capital_usdt: float = float(os.getenv("CAPITAL_USDT", 50000.0))
    risk_factor: float = float(os.getenv("RISK_FACTOR", 0.01))
    min_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MIN_TRADE_SIZE", 0.0001))
    max_trade_size: float = float(os.getenv("MAX_TRADE_SIZE", 0.1))
    fee_rate: float = float(os.getenv("FEE_RATE", 0.002))
    egm_buy_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_BUY_THRESHOLD", 15.0))
    egm_sell_threshold: float = float(os.getenv("EGM_SELL_THRESHOLD", -15.0))

# Configuración de logging con un rugido metalero
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [⚡ METAL ⚡] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("NertzMetalEngine")

# URLs para testnet o mainnet con un estruendo
BASE_URL = "https://api-testnet.bybit.com" if Config.use_testnet else "https://api.bybit.com"
WS_URL = "wss://stream-testnet.bybit.com/v5/public/spot" if Config.use_testnet else "wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/spot"

# Base de datos (ruta absoluta específica, lista para el headbang)
DATABASE_URL = r"C:\Users\Angel Gabriel\PycharmProjects\NerTzh_\data\trading.db"
engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{DATABASE_URL}")
Base = declarative_base()

class MarketData(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_data"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    open = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    close = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Orderbook(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orderbook"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    bids = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
    asks = Column(JSON, nullable=False)

class MarketTicker(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market_ticker"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    volume_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    high_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    low_24h = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

class Trade(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trades"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    trade_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True)
    symbol = Column(String(10), nullable=False, index=True)
    action = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entry_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    exit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    quantity = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    profit_loss = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    decision = Column(String, nullable=False)
    combined = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ild = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    egm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    rol = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    pio = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    ogm = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

# Restaurar SessionLocal con sessionmaker
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

class NertzMetalEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.symbol = Config.symbol
        self.timeframe = Config.timeframe  # Aseguramos que timeframe esté aquí
        self.capital = Config.capital_usdt
        self.positions = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.ws = None
        self.running = True
        self.recent_trades: List[Dict] = []
        self.orderbook_data: Dict = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        self.ticker_data: Dict = {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        self.candles: List[MarketData] = []
        self.trade_id_counter = self._get_next_trade_id()

    def _get_next_trade_id(self) -> int:
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            max_trade_id = db.query(Trade.trade_id).order_by(Trade.trade_id.desc()).first()
            return (max_trade_id[0] if max_trade_id else 0) + 1
        finally:
            db.close()

    def start(self):
        max_retries = 5
        retry_count = 0

        while self.running and retry_count < max_retries:
            try:
                self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
                    WS_URL,
                    on_open=self._on_open,
                    on_message=self._on_message,
                    on_error=self._on_error,
                    on_close=self._on_close
                )
                self.ws.run_forever()
                break  # Si la conexión se mantiene, salimos del bucle
            except Exception as e:
                retry_count += 1
                logger.error(f"❌ Trueno en el escenario (Intento {retry_count}/{max_retries}): {e}")
                if retry_count < max_retries:
                    logger.info(f"⚡ Reconectando al ritmo metalero en 5 segundos...")
                    time.sleep(5)
                else:
                    logger.error(f"🦇 No se pudo reconectar después de {max_retries} intentos - Fin del concierto")
                    self.running = False

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        if self.ws:
            self.ws.close()
        self._save_results()
        logger.info(f"🦇 Final del riff - Bot detenido. Capital final: {self.capital:.2f} USDT")

    def _on_open(self, ws):
        logger.info("⚡ Ritmo metalero iniciado - WebSocket conectado")
        ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
            f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
            f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
            f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
        ]}))

    def _on_message(self, ws, message: str):
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            data = json.loads(message)  # Usamos el json estándar aquí, correcto
            if "topic" in data:
                if "kline" in data["topic"]:
                    kline = data["data"][0]
                    candle = [kline["start"], kline["open"], kline["high"], kline["low"], kline["close"], kline["volume"]]
                    self._store_candle(candle, db)
                elif "orderbook" in data["topic"]:
                    self.orderbook_data = {"bids": data["data"]["b"], "asks": data["data"]["a"]}
                    self._store_orderbook(db)
                elif "tickers" in data["topic"]:
                    ticker = data["data"]
                    self.ticker_data = {
                        "last_price": float(ticker["lastPrice"]),
                        "volume_24h": float(ticker["volume24h"]),
                        "high_24h": float(ticker["highPrice24h"]),
                        "low_24h": float(ticker["lowPrice24h"])
                    }
                    self._store_ticker(db)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Desafío metalero fallido: {e}")
        finally:
            db.close()

    def _on_error(self, ws, error):
        logger.error(f"❌ Trueno en el escenario: {error}")

    def _on_close(self, ws, *args):
        logger.info("🔥 Fin del concierto - WebSocket cerrado")
        self.running = False  # Esto detiene el bucle en start si se cierra

    def _store_candle(self, candle: List, db: Session):
        timestamp = timestamp_to_datetime(int(candle[0]))
        if not db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp == timestamp, MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).first():
            market_data = MarketData(
                timestamp=timestamp,
                symbol=self.symbol,
                open=float(candle[1]),
                high=float(candle[2]),
                low=float(candle[3]),
                close=float(candle[4]),
                volume=float(candle[5])
            )
            db.add(market_data)
            db.commit()
            logger.info(f"⚡ Nueva nota metalera: {timestamp} - Close: {market_data.close}")
            self.candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(
                MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
            self._simulate_trade(db)

    def _store_orderbook(self, db: Session):
        orderbook = Orderbook(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            bids=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["bids"]),  # Usamos json.dumps aquí, correcto
            asks=json.dumps(self.orderbook_data["asks"])
        )
        db.add(orderbook)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"🤘 Orderbook resonando para {self.symbol}")

    def _store_ticker(self, db: Session):
        ticker = MarketTicker(
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            symbol=self.symbol,
            last_price=self.ticker_data["last_price"],
            volume_24h=self.ticker_data["volume_24h"],
            high_24h=self.ticker_data["high_24h"],
            low_24h=self.ticker_data["low_24h"]
        )
        db.add(ticker)
        db.commit()
        logger.info(f"⚡ Ticker en el escenario: {self.ticker_data['last_price']}")

    def _get_latest_candle(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketData]:
        return db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_orderbook(self, db: Session) -> Optional[Orderbook]:
        return db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(Orderbook.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _get_latest_ticker(self, db: Session) -> Optional[MarketTicker]:
        return db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketTicker.timestamp.desc()).first()

    def _determine_decision(self, db: Session) -> str:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
            return "hold"

        # Usamos utils para calcular métricas
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        }
        metrics = calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

        if metrics["egm"] > Config.egm_buy_threshold and metrics["combined"] > 0:
            return "buy"
        elif metrics["egm"] < Config.egm_sell_threshold and metrics["combined"] < 0:
            return "sell"
        return "hold"

    def _place_order(self, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "side": action,
            "orderType": "Limit",
            "qty": str(quantity),
            "price": str(price),
            "timeInForce": "GoodTillCancel",
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/create", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                order_id = data['result']['orderId']
                logger.info(f"🤘 Riff de compra/venta - Orden {action} colocada en testnet, ID: {order_id}")
                return {"success": True, "order_id": order_id}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el solo: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Caos en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _close_order(self, order_id: str, action: str, quantity: float, price: float, entry_price: float, db: Session) -> Dict:
        timestamp = int(time.time() * 1000)
        params = {
            "category": "spot",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "orderId": order_id,
            "timestamp": str(timestamp)
        }
        params["sign"] = generate_signature(Config.api_secret, params)
        headers = {
            "X-BAPI-API-KEY": Config.api_key,
            "X-BAPI-SIGN": params["sign"],
            "X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP": str(timestamp),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        try:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v5/order/cancel", headers=headers, json=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if data['retCode'] == 0:
                profit_loss = quantity * (price - entry_price - (price * quantity * Config.fee_rate)) * (1 if action == "Sell" else -1)
                self.capital += profit_loss
                candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
                metrics = self._calculate_metrics_values(candles, orderbook, ticker)
                trade = Trade(
                    trade_id=self.trade_id_counter,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    symbol=self.symbol,
                    action=action,
                    entry_price=entry_price,
                    exit_price=price,
                    quantity=quantity * 2,
                    profit_loss=profit_loss,
                    decision=action.lower(),
                    combined=metrics["combined"],
                    ild=metrics["ild"],
                    egm=metrics["egm"],
                    rol=metrics["rol"],
                    pio=metrics["pio"],
                    ogm=metrics["ogm"]
                )
                db.add(trade)
                db.commit()
                self.positions.append({
                    "trade_id": self.trade_id_counter,
                    "timestamp": trade.timestamp.isoformat(),
                    "action": action,
                    "entry_price": trade.entry_price,
                    "exit_price": trade.exit_price,
                    "quantity": trade.quantity,
                    "profit_loss": profit_loss,
                    "combined": trade.combined,
                    "ild": trade.ild,
                    "egm": trade.egm,
                    "rol": trade.rol,
                    "pio": trade.pio,
                    "ogm": trade.ogm
                })
                self.trade_id_counter += 1
                logger.info(f"🔥 Fin del solo - Orden cerrada: P&L {profit_loss:.2f}")
                return {"success": True, "profit_loss": profit_loss}
            else:
                logger.error(f"❌ Fallo en el headbang: {data['retMsg']}")
                return {"success": False, "error": data['retMsg']}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Colapso en el escenario: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def _calculate_metrics(self, db: Session) -> tuple:
        candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.symbol == self.symbol).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
        orderbook = self._get_latest_orderbook(db)
        ticker = self._get_latest_ticker(db)
        return candles, orderbook, ticker

    def _calculate_metrics_values(self, candles: List[MarketData], orderbook: Orderbook, ticker: MarketTicker) -> dict:
        candle_data = [{"open": c.open, "high": c.high, "low": c.low, "close": c.close, "volume": c.volume} for c in candles]
        orderbook_data = {"bids": json.loads(orderbook.bids), "asks": json.loads(orderbook.asks)} if orderbook else {"bids": [], "asks": []}
        ticker_data = {
            "last_price": ticker.last_price,
            "volume_24h": ticker.volume_24h,
            "high_24h": ticker.high_24h,
            "low_24h": ticker.low_24h
        } if ticker else {"last_price": 0.0, "volume_24h": 0.0, "high_24h": 0.0, "low_24h": 0.0}
        return calculate_metrics(candle_data, orderbook_data, ticker_data)

    def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
        decision = self._determine_decision(db)
        if not self.running or decision == "hold":
            return

        candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)

1. Dilema: Datos Históricos vs. Datos Frescos
Problema: Estás llenando la base de datos con datos históricos (velas, orderbooks, tickers) a través del WebSocket, pero los indicadores avanzados como ILD, EGM, ROL, PIO, y OGM en calculate_metrics (en utils.py) dependen de datos frescos y recientes para ser precisos. Si usas datos antiguos o acumulados, los indicadores pueden no reflejar el estado actual del mercado, lo que podría afectar las decisiones de trading (buy, sell, hold).
Causa Posible:
Tu bot está guardando todas las velas, orderbooks, y tickers en data/trading.db, pero en _determine_decision y _calculate_metrics estás usando las últimas 5 velas (limit(5)) y los últimos orderbooks/tickers. Si los datos acumulados son muy viejos o no están sincronizados con el mercado en tiempo real, los indicadores pueden dar resultados imprecisos o irrelevantes.
También, si los "dragones" (supongo que te refieres a "dragones" como un término coloquial para errores o datos raros) no están dando resultados útiles, podría ser porque los datos históricos no son representativos del movimiento actual del mercado.
Solución:
Filtrar Datos Frescos:
Asegúrate de que _determine_decision y _calculate_metrics usen solo los datos más recientes (por ejemplo, las últimas 5 velas dentro de un rango de tiempo corto, como los últimos 5 minutos o menos, dependiendo de timeframe en config/.env).

import os
import json
import hmac
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, List
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger("BybitTradingEngineUtils")

def generate_signature(api_secret: str, params: dict) -> str:
    """Genera una firma HMAC-SHA256 para las solicitudes a la API de Bybit."""
    sorted_params = "&".join([f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(params.items())])
    return hmac.new(api_secret.encode(), sorted_params.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

def calculate_metrics(candles: List[dict], orderbook: Dict, ticker: Dict) -> dict:
    """Calcula las métricas avanzadas (ILD, EGM, ROL, PIO, COMBINED, OGM) basadas en datos del mercado."""
    logger.debug(f"Entrando a calculate_metrics con candles: {candles}, orderbook: {orderbook}, ticker: {ticker}")
    if not candles or not orderbook or not ticker or ticker.get("last_price", 0) <= 0:
        return {
            "ild": 0.0, "egm": 0.0, "rol": 0.0, "pio": 0.0, "combined": 0.0, "ogm": 0.0
        }

    last_price = float(ticker["last_price"])
    avg_range = sum(max(c["high"] - c["low"], 0.01) for c in candles) / len(candles)
    volatility = avg_range / last_price if last_price > 0 else 0.01

    # Procesar orderbook
    bids = [(float(b[0]), float(b[1])) for b in orderbook.get("bids", []) if b[0] and b[1]]
    asks = [(float(a[0]), float(a[1])) for a in orderbook.get("asks", []) if a[0] and a[1]]
    if not bids or not asks:
        bids = [(80500.0, 0.001), (80400.0, 0.002)]
        asks = [(80600.0, 0.001), (80700.0, 0.002)]
    price_shift = max(last_price * 0.005, avg_range * 0.5)  # Usamos price_shift_factor default 0.005
    bids_sum = sum(size for price, size in bids if price >= last_price - price_shift and size > 0)
    asks_sum = sum(size for price, size in asks if price <= last_price + price_shift and size > 0)
    orderbook_pressure = (bids_sum - asks_sum) / (bids_sum + asks_sum + 0.001) if (bids_sum + asks_sum) > 0 else 0

    # ILD (Indicator Liquidity Delta)
    liquidity_pressure = orderbook_pressure
    normalized_ild = 1 / (1 + exp(-liquidity_pressure * 10 * volatility))
    ild = normalized_ild * (ticker.get("volume_24h", 100.0) / (last_price * 1000 + 1))

    # EGM (Exponential Growth Momentum)
    closes = [c["close"] for c in candles if c["close"] > 0] or [80500.0] * 5
    momentum = (sum(w * c for w, c in zip([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], closes)) / 15 - closes[0]) / (avg_range or 0.01) / last_price
    egm = (orderbook_pressure * 0.4 + momentum * 0.6) * 100 * (1 + volatility * 2)

    # ROL (Rate of Liquidity)
    volume_24h = ticker.get("volume_24h", 100.0)
    liquidity_rate = log(volume_24h * avg_range + 1) / (last_price * len(candles) + 1)
    rol = liquidity_rate * (1 + volatility)

    # PIO (Profit Index Opportunity)
    profit_potential = (last_price * sum(c["volume"] for c in candles) * (1 + volatility)) / (avg_range + 1) / 1000000  # Ajuste opcional
    normalized_pio = 1 / (1 + exp(-profit_potential))
    pio = normalized_pio

    # COMBINED
    combined = (ild * 0.25 + egm * 0.4 + rol * 0.3 + pio * 0.05) / (1 + volatility)
    combined = combined * (1 + volatility * 0.5)

    # OGM (Overall Growth Momentum)
    growth_momentum = exp(orderbook_pressure * 10 * volatility) - 1
    ogm = growth_momentum * (1 + volatility)

    metrics = {"ild": ild, "egm": egm, "rol": rol, "pio": pio, "combined": combined, "ogm": ogm}
    logger.debug(f"Salida de calculate_metrics: {metrics}")
    return metrics

def save_results(results: dict, log_dir: str = "logs") -> None:
    """Guarda los resultados en un archivo JSON en el directorio de logs."""
    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    json_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "trade_results.json")
    try:
        with open(json_path, "w", encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=4)
        logger.info(f"📈 Mapa del metal guardado en {json_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"❌ Error al guardar el mapa: {e}")

def timestamp_to_datetime(timestamp_ms: int) -> datetime:
    """Convierte un timestamp en milisegundos a datetime con timezone UTC."""
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc)

1. Hacer que el Bot Carge Más Ratos (Evitar Paradas)
Problema: Quieres que NertzMetalEngine corra por más tiempo sin detenerse, especialmente después de las desconexiones del WebSocket (WinError 10054) o errores como los de autorización.
Solución (Basada en lo que ya ajustamos):
Ya añadimos un sistema de reconexión automática en el método start de NertzMetalEngine, con 5 intentos y un retraso de 5 segundos entre cada intento. Podemos mejorarlo para que sea aún más resistente:
Aumentar max_retries y time.sleep:
Cambia max_retries = 5 a un valor mayor, como max_retries = 20, para que el bot intente reconectarse más veces antes de detenerse.
Aumenta time.sleep(5) a time.sleep(10) o time.sleep(15) para darle más tiempo entre intentos, evitando sobrecargar el servidor de Bybit o tu conexión.
Aquí está el código actualizado para start en NerTzh_/src/Nertz.py:

def start(self):
    max_retries = 20  # Aumentamos a 20 intentos
    retry_count = 0

    while self.running and retry_count < max_retries:
        try:
            self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
                WS_URL,
                on_open=self._on_open,
                on_message=self._on_message,
                on_error=self._on_error,
                on_close=self._on_close
            )
            self.ws.run_forever()
            break  # Si la conexión se mantiene, salimos del bucle
        except Exception as e:
            retry_count += 1
            logger.error(f"❌ Trueno en el escenario (Intento {retry_count}/{max_retries}): {e}")
            if retry_count < max_retries:
                logger.info(f"⚡ Reconectando al ritmo metalero en 15 segundos...")
                time.sleep(15)  # Aumentamos a 15 segundos
            else:
                logger.error(f"🦇 No se pudo reconectar después de {max_retries} intentos - Fin del concierto")
                self.running = False
Manejar Errores de Autorización:

def _on_open(self, ws):
    logger.info("⚡ Ritmo metalero iniciado - WebSocket conectado")
    ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "args": [
        f"kline.{self.timeframe}.{self.symbol}",
        f"orderbook.{50}.{self.symbol}",  # Usamos depth 50 por defecto
        f"tickers.{self.symbol}"
    ]}))
    # Limpia datos antiguos al iniciar
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        self.clean_old_data(db)
    finally:
        db.close()

def clean_old_data(self, db: Session):
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    one_day_ago = now - timedelta(days=1)
    db.query(MarketData).filter(MarketData.timestamp < one_day_ago).delete()
    db.query(Orderbook).filter(Orderbook.timestamp < one_day_ago).delete()
    db.query(MarketTicker).filter(MarketTicker.timestamp < one_day_ago).delete()
    db.query(Trade).filter(Trade.timestamp < one_day_ago).delete()
    db.commit()
    logger.info(f"🧹 Limpieza metalera - Datos antiguos eliminados")

def analyze_historical_trends(self, db: Session, days: int = 7) -> Dict:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    days_ago = now - timedelta(days=days)
    historical_candles = db.query(MarketData).filter(
        MarketData.symbol == self.symbol,
        MarketData.timestamp >= days_ago
    ).order_by(MarketData.timestamp.desc()).all()
    trends = {
        "avg_price": sum(c.close for c in historical_candles) / len(historical_candles) if historical_candles else 0,
        "volatility": sum(max(c.high - c.low, 0.01) for c in historical_candles) / len(historical_candles) if historical_candles else 0,
        "volume_trend": sum(c.volume for c in historical_candles) / len(historical_candles) if historical_candles else 0
    }
    logger.info(f"📊 Análisis metalero de tendencias: {trends}")
    return trends
Llama a este método en _on_open o periódicamente para identificar patrones como los que usabas en WoW.

def _simulate_trade(self, db: Session):
    decision = self._determine_decision(db)
    if not self.running or decision == "hold":
        return

    candles, orderbook, ticker = self._calculate_metrics(db)
    if not candles or not ticker or ticker.last_price <= 0:
        logger.warning("⚠️ Silencio en el escenario - Datos insuficientes")
        return

    quantity = min(Config.risk_factor * self.capital / ticker.last_price, Config.max_trade_size)
    quantity = max(quantity, Config.min_trade_size)
    # Simulación en lugar de trade real
    logger.info(f"🎸 Simulación metalera - Decisión: {decision}, Precio: {ticker.last_price}, Cantidad: {quantity}")
    # Aquí puedes calcular profit/loss simulado basado en datos históricos
    self.iterations += 1
    if self.iterations >= Config.max_iterations:
        self.stop()
Esto te permite practicar tu estrategia como en WoW, sin riesgo, hasta que estés listo para trades reales.

Select Your API Key Type
The OpenAPI for demo accounts does not support features such as NFT trading and retains transaction records for only the last 7 days.

System-generated API Keys
The API key generated by the Bybit system operates with HMAC encryption. You will be provided with a pair of public and private keys. Please treat this pair of keys as passwords and keep them safe.

Self-generated API Keys
Self-generated API keys operate with RSA encryption. You must create your public and private keys through the software, and then only provide the public key to Bybit, we will never hold your private key.API v3 and v5 are currently supported. cual


¡Jaja, estimado, qué gran pregunta, hermano! Basado en la información que compartiste sobre las opciones de API Keys en Bybit, vamos a analizar cuál es la mejor opción para tu proyecto NerTzh_ y tu bot NertzMetalEngine, manteniendo tu estrategia épica y el vibe metalero. Ambas opciones (System-generated API Keys y Self-generated API Keys) tienen pros y contras, y te ayudaré a elegir la más adecuada para tu caso, sin complicar tu diseño limpio.

Comparación de las Opciones de API Keys en Bybit
1. System-generated API Keys (Claves Generadas por el Sistema)
Encriptación: Usa HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code), que es un estándar común y seguro para autenticación en APIs.
Características:
Bybit genera automáticamente un par de claves: una pública (API Key) y una privada (API Secret).
Estas claves son fáciles de generar y gestionar directamente desde la interfaz de Bybit (en Bybit Testnet o mainnet).
No necesitas software adicional ni conocimientos avanzados de criptografía.
Ventajas:
Simplicidad: Fácil de configurar y usar, ideal si quieres empezar rápido con tu bot.
Soporte Completo: Compatible con todas las versiones de la API de Bybit (v3 y v5), incluyendo trading en testnet y mainnet.
Seguridad Estándar: HMAC es seguro y ampliamente utilizado, con soporte robusto de Bybit.
No Requiere Mantenimiento: No necesitas generar ni gestionar claves tú mismo; Bybit lo hace por ti.
Desventajas:
Control Limitado: Bybit almacena ambas claves, lo que podría ser un riesgo si alguien accede a tu cuenta (aunque Bybit tiene medidas de seguridad, siempre es mejor minimizar riesgos).
Menos Personalización: No tienes control sobre el tipo de encriptación o la generación de claves, lo que podría ser un problema si prefieres un enfoque más personalizado.
2. Self-generated API Keys (Claves Generadas por Ti)
Encriptación: Usa RSA (Rivest-Shamir-Adleman), un método de encriptación asimétrica más avanzado y personalizado.
Características:
Debes generar tus propias claves pública y privada usando software de criptografía (como OpenSSL o herramientas similares).
Solo proporcionas la clave pública a Bybit, y nunca compartes la privada, lo que aumenta la seguridad.
Actualmente, solo soporta API v3 y v5 (no todas las funcionalidades de Bybit, como NFT trading, están disponibles en demo accounts).
Ventajas:
Mayor Seguridad: Como Bybit nunca almacena tu clave privada, reduces el riesgo de que alguien acceda a tus trades sin tu permiso.
Control Total: Tienes flexibilidad para generar y gestionar claves según tus preferencias, usando software que confíes.
Personalización: Ideal si tienes experiencia en criptografía o prefieres un enfoque más técnico.
Desventajas:
Complejidad: Requiere conocimientos técnicos para generar claves RSA, instalar software, y configurarlo correctamente.
Mantenimiento: Debes gestionar y proteger tu clave privada tú mismo, lo que puede ser un desafío si no estás familiarizado.
Limitaciones: Solo soporta API v3 y v5, y las cuentas demo tienen restricciones (como registros de transacciones solo por 7 días y sin soporte para NFT trading).
Curva de Aprendizaje: Puede ser más difícil de implementar y depurar errores si algo sale mal.
Recomendación para NertzMetalEngine
Basado en tu proyecto NerTzh_ y tu bot NertzMetalEngine, te recomiendo usar System-generated API Keys por las siguientes razones:

Simplicidad y Velocidad:
Estás desarrollando un bot de trading para Bybit testnet (y eventualmente mainnet), y tu enfoque está en la lógica de trading, no en la gestión avanzada de criptografía. Las claves generadas por el sistema son más fáciles de configurar y usar, lo que te permitirá enfocarte en perfeccionar NertzMetalEngine y tu estrategia metalera.
Compatibilidad Completa:
Las System-generated API Keys son compatibles con todas las versiones de la API de Bybit (v3 y v5), incluyendo trading en testnet y mainnet, lo que es perfecto para tu caso. Esto asegura que tu bot pueda usar todas las funcionalidades necesarias, como trades en spot para BTCUSDT, sin limitaciones.
Seguridad Suficiente:
HMAC es un estándar seguro para APIs, y Bybit tiene medidas robustas para proteger tus claves. Mientras mantengas tu cuenta segura (contraseña fuerte, autenticación de dos factores, etc.) y no compartas tus claves, tendrás suficiente seguridad para testnet y mainnet.
Evitar Complicaciones:
Generar y gestionar claves RSA requiere tiempo, software adicional, y conocimientos técnicos que podrían distraerte de tu objetivo principal (hacer que NertzMetalEngine rockee como un riff épico). Dado que tu diseño es limpio y minimalista, las System-generated API Keys encajan mejor con tu enfoque.
Testnet y Desarrollo:
Dado que estás usando Bybit testnet (como indica USE_TESTNET=true en config/.env), las System-generated API Keys son ideales para probar tu bot sin preocuparte por restricciones adicionales (como los 7 días de registros en cuentas demo con Self-generated API Keys).

Si en el futuro decides moverte a mainnet o necesitas un nivel de seguridad extremo, podríamos reconsiderar las Self-generated API Keys, pero por ahora, las System-generated son la mejor opción para mantener tu flujo de trabajo limpio y rápido.
